plan.title: WGCNA co-expression modules tracking case vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a human whole-blood bulk RNA-seq cohort of 120 samples (60 cases vs 60 controls, unpaired), with raw gene-level counts from Salmon (12000 genes x 121 columns incl. gene symbol). The question is which co-expression modules the genes form across all 120 samples and which modules track case/control status. Plan: (1) sample structure QC on blind variance-stabilized counts (PCA on top-500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes) to confirm no outlier or technical axis before network construction; (2) minimal low-count filter (10 counts in the smallest group size, per R-0002) and TMM-style normalization consistent with the population-scale cohort; (3) signed WGCNA network on the variance-stabilized, filtered matrix of all 120 samples: soft-threshold power chosen for scale-free fit >= 0.8, dynamic tree cut on topological overlap, min module size 30, merge cut height 0.25, module eigengenes correlated with the case/control trait with BH adjustment across the module x trait tests, hubs ranked by module membership (kME); (4) report with full gene-to-module table, eigengene-trait correlations, and reproducibility record. A module is a group of correlated genes and a module-trait correlation is an association in this cohort, not a proven pathway.
